nom: Peter Thomas Roth Water Drench Hyaluronic Glow Serum

avis.texte: The hydrating and glow effects of this serum are a plus, but the smell is so bad. I cannot get past it
I've been using this for almost 5 months! It's very hydrating and makes your skin glow amazingly! The product is smelly but most products that work as good as this does. Almost perfect formula.

avis.titre: Love the texture, hate the smell
avis.texte: I've always loved PTR products but I'm on the fence about this one. What I love: the texture, the ease of absorption and how my face feels after using it. What I don't love: the smell. It reminds me of something that has been sitting around for a long time collecting dust. 🫢 I wish it smelled better as that may be the reason I stop using it.
I've tried soo many hydrants but water drench hyaluronic glow serum surpasses them all. Id recommend this a thousand times.

I have been using the water drench line for quite awhile. I have tried to take a break from the products and noticed a decline in my skin. My skin looks dewy and my lines have softened. This keeps my face very hydrated as I use Rx strength tretinoin the highest percentage, so my face is very dry. These are the only products that help me retain moisture. They work best when bought together. This glow serum is amazing. A little goes a long way. My skin feels so buttery soft. Your only regret will be not trying this sooner!

I love other water drench products but this serum is awful. The scent is terrible, gives me instant headache. I don't think it does anything good to my skin. Skin feels dry. Wouldn't buy it again. Not worth the price.

This serum is glorious for about 2 hours. I am 43, fine lines, dry thyroid skin, in dry Colorado climate. Upon application after my other serums (tranaximic acid & peptides (naturium) I applied this. It played very well with all my prior applied active ingredients and gave a beautiful glow - NOT sparkly, not pearly, not glittery, not dripping with grease. A subtle, dampish glow appropriate for mature skin. No fragrance, and not sticky. Quite a nice plumping effect. However it had evaporated witin 2 hours. It will work fabulously for younger or oilier skined folks.
PTR's glow serum is wonderful! It makes my skin feel hydrated with no stcky residue.
I have been using this serum for over a year. It is super hydrating, no heavy scent and works well with layering serums. I have purchased it multiple times and carry it wherever i go.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I've tried several types of skin care products. Peter Thomas Roth serum along with his other products really helped my skin. It looks brighter.

I am going to continue to use this to see if I notice any results but this smells like paint water. I'm a person who looks for results and the experience of skincare and this smell absolutely ruins the experience

Not only do i use this on my face daily, i use it on my hands as well and the results are amazing! I struggle with very dry skin and this has been the game changer ive been looking for! No it doesn't smell great and yea its expensive but with the results im getting, im a customer for life!

I was recommended this product and I've fallen in love with it. It is my go-to for my daily routine. I have naturally dry skin and this product does wonders even after the first application! It goes on light and smoothly. It's not sticky and feels almost as if you're applying water to your skin. It's AMAZING and have not bought any other serum! Thanks PTR!

I put just a DAB of this on my left hand at Ulta and within 30 seconds my hand started burning, I went to the bathroom and washed it off after about a minute of it burning, 5 minutes later there were red bumps on my hand, 10 minutes after that my left arm started itching, then my neck and chest then my right arm and then my abdomen. I have only ever had a reaction like this once to a topical product. If you have sensitive skin or food allergies please be careful with this product!
Smells Awful. Got a second one thinking the first may have been an old one that sneaked through but no. It smells rancid. I will never buy this particular product again.

I ordered a couple of months ago. Just opened. Smells really bad. Went to the local Sephora, same thing. Looked up expiration dates. Shameful, the product had 2 months left when I received it. The product on the shelf was expired. 2nd time this has happened with PTR products.
I use this daily under my foundation. It absorbs quickly, feels silky and my skin loves it.
Great moisturizer. I use it on my neck, chest, and some burned/peeling areas on my face. Made a huge difference in my skin's texture.

Goes on beautifully and goes a long long way. You don't need very much to get a lovely glow on your entire face and neck. I've been using the glow serum for only three weeks and already see a difference in my skin. It looks and feels dewier and fresher!
It works fine but the smell is absolutely disgusting. It smells like old fryer oil I wish I could return it honestly

I'm obsessed with this serum. It hydrates without being heavy, helps with redness, texture, and fine lines and doesn't pill under makeup. I love the entire PTR water drench line but this is my favorite product.
The minute I apply this product to my skin I instantly see a change in my complexion.
I have combination skin and this is perfect! I love this serum. It is pricy but the quality is amazing and only takes a little. Will continue to purchase!
Love this water cream serum! My skin feels very smooth. You will need a lotion over it but it's the perfect based for any skincare routine (in my opinion). I'm hooked!
Your skin immediately feels like silk. I add moisturizer after this serum. You have a wonderful glow with this & after a week, lines are definitely less noticeable!! I'm very happy with this product!
I totally love this product! I have dry skin and it has changed my life! My skin is hydrated and soft again! I look like I am glowing!! :-)

I got this first as a free sample in the trial size. Instantly feel in love. The trial size lasted me 2 weeks and I was using it am and pm. My amazing husband knew how much I loved it so he bought me the full size for VDAY! This has changed my skin dramatically. My pores are reduced in size, my skin really does have a dewy glow to it, and my makeup always looks awesome. It goes on so well and is not greasy or oily feeling. I'm am do addicted to this produce and I'm ready to by many more PTR products!
It smells old. Like it's an expired bottle…sad I was looking forward to trying it

avis.titre: Water drench hyaluronic closer in in
avis.texte: I was able to try this serum with a sample product that Peter Thomas Roth sent me with my first order. I love getting samples that I can try and see how they work on my skin before ordering the full-size! This gift was perfect for that chance! I do love it!

avis.titre: Love this serum, my face looks so much younger
avis.texte: I use this as a night serum after washing face. In the morning my skin is glowing, tones are even and I find I only need my PTR moisturizer, a little concealer under eyes, mascara, dash of lip color and good to go. The fine lines around eyes are almost completely gone and around mouth. I am 74 ys old and thanks to this product look far younger.
Love this stuff. I've been using it a little over 3 months and I love what it's done for my skin.

avis.titre: Pearl subtle look with Glow Serum!
avis.texte: It gives your skin that certain finished look that you didn't realize you never had! I love this product. It's a keeper.

I got this as a sample size, although it smells really bad like I'm putting melted crayons on my face, it actually does wonders for my skin. For this price though, I wouldn't purchase it. There are other cheaper hyaluronic acid alternatives that are just as good!

avis.titre: My skin is hydrated and glowing
avis.texte: This is my favorite product. I love this serum, I see an instant glow right after I apply it. Hydrating.

I purchased this because I have severe eczema that leaves my face severely dry and red. I wanted a deep hydration and love the dewey look. I decided to purchase this even though it was quite pricey. I used three pumps and applied a generous amount all over my clean face. I noticed afterwards it tends to leave a bit of sticky feeling. Ten minutes later my face felt soft but it didn't leave any sort of a dewey finish. Nor did it 'immensely hydrate' either. I suppose I'll use it for a makeup primer

This is the perfect pick me up glow serum. It leaves my skin hydrated and glowing. I sometimes use it in combination with the water drench moisturizer. It is a must have for my daily skin care routine.
Wasn't bad but there are many HA products that work equally well for a mid price point.

avis.titre: Makes my wrinkly hands look young again!
avis.texte: Decided that I do not need to try one more sample on my face - why not on my hands. Love that it soaks in fast and I can honestly say that the wrinkles seem less. That is a plus for me! So thank you Ulta for this sample!

I have only been usingWater Drench Hyaluronic Glow Serum for a few weeks and I see a wonderful hydrated glow to my skin. I also purchased it for my 23 year old daughter who has dry skin and she is in love with how her skin looks and feels.
Smell is not appealing and no noticeable improvement. Unimpressed.
My go-to! Absorbs like magic & does as it claims! Can't live without!
Feels like silk going on and really helps mositurize in the winter!

This gives your skin a nice glow. I love it. I have oily skin so I have to be careful what glowy or dewy stuff I put on it because it can looks greasy, but not with this. It makes my skin looks so hydrated and gives it a nice glow.

I LOVE this new PTR serum. I was hesitant at first because it claims to provide a dewy finish and I don't care for dewy look so much, but I wanted a new serum with a lot of hydration and something to help with fine lines/wrinkles. I am a fan of other (not all) PTR products and currently use the moisturizer in the same line. The other serum and the toner mist are good as well, so in thought I'd give this serum a try. This serum absorbs fast, it plums, and leaves my skin looking radiant and healthy. It layers well with my other skin products as well. So glad I got it!
This is amazing! I was very surprised at the instant glow it gave me. I will definitely recommend!
This would've gotten four stars from me due to its effectiveness BUT it has such a fake cotton candy bubble gum scent it makes me feel as though I'm using a child's marketed product sold at Claire's!

It works well in the sense that it does it's job -- I found that it hydrates my skin the way I want it to but it smells so off. You eventually get a little used to it but it's not a pleasant scent. I wanted to try a different serum because I really loved all the PTR products I've used so far but unfortunately, this one is one I won't be buying again.
Doesn't mix well with other serums, my face felt dry after use, so disappointing

I wanted a hydrating serum that also exfoliated a bit, but wouldn't be too much for my rosacea to handle. This product has lactic acid, and it has never once irritated my skin. I even create a cocktail of vitamin C serum plus this one, mix them together in my hands, and spread them on my face. This is an excellent serum and I'll repurchase for sure.
So smooth. Feels like satin when you put it on. When I started using it I had over exfoliated around my nose and this has helped it heal!
It smells terrible and my face does not feel hydrated. This is after 2 weeks of using it.
This definitely leaves my skin with a healthy glow and I can definitely feel my face is more moisturized. I use with the water drench moisturizer.
This serum hydrates and plump my skin right after I use it. I have tried other brands too but this one is best so far which completely meets my skin needs.
This serum is indeed very moisturizing and lasts throughout the day. It absorbs readily and feels good on your face. I highly recommend this product to add moisture to your regimen.

I'm still sorting out the best places on my face to use it, as I have combination skin. I have recently started using your salicylic pads and the 2% salicylic wash, twice daily. I am certainty seeing a great improvement in lowering the number of small breakouts around my mouth and on my cheek bones. I also can see that the pores on my nose are shrinking back to normal as well. Menopause has been hell on my skin! I never had skin troubles as a child, or teenager. So, managing this new and different skin care routine, is quite challenging to me. I am very grateful that PTR's products have been so helpful to me! I am sure that once I get my hormonal blemishes under control, there will be other PTR products I will use with as much success!

This stuff is Ahhhmazing! I don't like writing too many reviews on items that are just okay, but I was shocked the moment I first used it, like seriously. I have been using this for a month now, and I was shocked. The consistency was weird out of the pump, but it slides so easily all over your face. I use two pumps, and find that's enough, but one pump might work as well. The biggest shock- I wasn't shiny, or greasy. The serum sunk in immediately, I wasn't greasy or shiny and I did have a glow. Seriously amazed and in shock. I love this. I have been battling depression for the past month, and some nights I wouldn't even wash my face, definitely wasn't drinking water or anything snd yet my face was still soft. My final test was how does it feel after dermaplaining my face, and it didn't burn! It's expensive but so worth it!!! I did get this for free for testing purposes from Peter Thomas Roth & Influenster, but I don't sugar coat anything and really test the products. I would have given a 5 star after the first time I tried it I was that impressed, but I needed to really see and it's passed my tests!
Wow what an amazing product! Leaves my skin feeling so smooth and refreshed like a had a really good nap
This is great for dry skin that needs some life. I have aging skin and other products didn't work so good. This one did.
Thw product is great. I use it every day. My complexion really glows!!

This serum is amazing honestly. I am a 28 year old male and I've always had issues with dry skin. I was so excited to try this product and was not disappointed, I will be ordering this again for sure. It absorbs into your skin so nicely, I've never felt anything like it! It only takes like 2 pumps to apply it to your face and neck because it spreads out so well. It also doesn't leave any residue or greasing on your skin after applying like a lot of products do! Immediately after applying my face feels so hydrated, smooth and healthy! The high hyaluronic acid content makes your skin look refreshed, plump, dewy and ready for anything! I highly recommend. I received this product as a gift from Peter Thomas Roth to review with my honest opinion.
